environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed as AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (HTTP API, no additional request validation). PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance with inventory database containing customer PII in related tables (customer_orders, payment_methods). Lambda execution role has full network access to RDS. Database user 'inventory_app' has SELECT privilege on all schemas including pg_catalog. No WAF or input filtering layer configured.

config.db_user_privileges: SELECT on all tables in public schema
config.api_gateway: HTTP API passthrough, no request validation
